# Stir & Simmer

> Tried-and-tested recipes from a real family kitchen — 125+ dishes cooked, eaten and approved at home, with honest write-ups, technique notes and pairing ideas.

Stir & Simmer is an independent UK food site focused on practical, repeatable home cooking. Every recipe has been cooked in a domestic kitchen (not a test studio), with ingredient quantities calibrated for UK supermarkets and metric measurements. Content covers British, Italian, Indian, Thai, Mediterranean and Middle Eastern dishes, alongside long-form technique guides.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://stirandsimmer.co.uk/): Featured recipes, seasonal picks and the latest additions.
- [All recipes](https://stirandsimmer.co.uk/recipes): Full searchable index of every published recipe.
- [Collections](https://stirandsimmer.co.uk/collections): Curated sets — quick & easy, romantic meals, baking, desserts, fish & seafood, Italian.
- [Kitchen Atlas](https://stirandsimmer.co.uk/kitchen-atlas): Recipes grouped by cuisine and region.
- [Meal planner](https://stirandsimmer.co.uk/meal-planner): Weekly planning tool drawing on the recipe library.
- [About](https://stirandsimmer.co.uk/about): Who runs the site and how recipes are tested.
- [Contact](https://stirandsimmer.co.uk/contact): Get in touch.

## Usage

Content may be referenced, summarised and cited with attribution to Stir & Simmer and a link back to the source URL. Wholesale reproduction of recipes is not permitted.
